01 / About NEO

Where engineering ideas become real businesses

The Nigerian Engineering Olympiad (NEO) is a nationwide competition that identifies, nurtures and celebrates engineering excellence among students in Nigerian tertiary institutions. Teams apply engineering principles to real-world challenges, supported by mentorship, funding and investor access, over an eight-month journey from idea to prototype to pitch.

InnovationOriginal, feasible solutions
MentorshipExperts guide every stage
FundingSeed capital for winners
EnterpriseInvestor-ready business plans

Read more about NEO

02 / Competition structure

Seven stages, one national stage

From campus selection to a Grand Finale pitch before industry leaders and investors.

Intra-InstitutionTop innovation chosen per university
Regional SelectionTop 5 from each of 6 geopolitical regions
PrototypingFunding and mentorship to build MVPs
RegionalsTop 12 judged on innovation and feasibility
Business PrepInvestor-ready business plans
Semi-FinalsTop 12 refine prototypes nationally
Grand FinaleTop 4 teams pitch to leaders and investors

03 / Cycle 1 · Grand Finale, Lagos · 30 June 2026

Meet the Cycle 1 winners

Four teams shared ₦110 million in seed funding to commercialise innovations in security, health, agriculture and energy.

1st · ₦50M grant

Ubuntu Safara

MAUT, Yola

Community-powered rapid alert and security intelligence network for rural Nigeria.

2nd place

Aurora Birth

University of Ibadan

HealthTech solution to reduce neonatal deaths from birth asphyxia.

3rd place

Sentra

University of Jos

Solar-powered, AI-enabled crop diagnostic device for early pest and disease detection.

4th place

Flameless

UNN, Nsukka

Modular platform converting associated gas into electricity for communities.
